title: Investigating Multi-Cultural Value Selection Biases in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating shifts in expressed values using World Values Survey (WVS) multiple-choice probing and open-ended sociopolitical generation under simultaneous, composite cultural identity cues.

Measuring distributional shifts in model answers when explicit country cues (e.g., 'I am from Japan') are introduced in the user prompt, using Jensen-Shannon distance to compare against the target country's baseline.
Assessing how implicit language cues (translating the query into a target country's dominant language) affect the cultural values expressed by the model in multiple-choice and open-ended responses.
